text: Assumption: The buffer remains valid until the query is completed — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The buffer remains valid until the query is completed — is this correct?
norm: the buffer remains valid until the query is completed
assumption: The buffer remains valid until the query is completed.
rationale: The necessity to keep the buffer available until completion of the query presumably follows from the asynchronous signature with an output pointer.

original.rationale: Aus der asynchronen Signatur mit Ausgabepointer folgt vermutlich die Notwendigkeit, den Puffer bis zum Abschluss der Abfrage bereitzuhalten.
